name: TM7 Lemon and Blueberry Drizzle Loaf
ingredients: 175 g butter, softened, plus extra for greasing
2 lemons, finely grated zest (reserve 40 g juice for drizzle)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 160°C fan / 180°C conventional. Grease and line a 2 lb loaf tin with baking paper. This is a homemade TM7 adaptation inspired by Mary Berry's lemon drizzle cake, not an original Mary Berry recipe.
Finely grate the zest of 2 lemons, avoiding the white pith. Reserve the zest for the batter and squeeze 40 g lemon juice for the drizzle.

Add 175 g softened butter, 175 g caster sugar, 200 g self-raising flour, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 3 large eggs, 25 g milk and the reserved lemon zest to the mixing bowl. Fit the lid and mix 30 sec / speed 4. No heat or butterfly is needed.
Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl. If the batter is not fully combined, fit the lid and mix for a further 10 sec / speed 4. Stop once smooth; avoid overmixing.
Add 150 g blueberries and gently fold them into the batter by hand using the spatula, with the blades stopped. Do not blend the berries. Frozen berries can be added directly from frozen.

Spoon the batter into the prepared loaf tin and level the top. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan / 180°C conventional for 55-70 minutes, checking from 50 minutes. Loosely cover with foil if browning too quickly. A skewer inserted into the sponge in the centre should come out without wet batter. Frozen berries may increase baking time.

Leave the baked loaf in its tin for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place a small bowl on the mixing bowl lid and weigh in 75 g granulated sugar and the reserved 40 g lemon juice. Remove the small bowl and stir together with a spoon; keep the sugar slightly grainy for a crunchy topping.
Prick the warm loaf with a skewer and spoon the lemon drizzle evenly over the top. Allow to cool completely in the tin, then lift out using the baking paper and cut into 10-12 slices.
